name: Bennu
desc: One of King Deshret's Seven Pillars, Saint Bennu, the Most-Radiant. Bennu is an intelligent construct fashioned by King Deshret, who entrusted him with the duty of guarding the gates of Aaru. He possesses a will of his own. He watches over the eternal utopia within Aaru — the Golden Slumber. Following the passing of King Deshret, he ceased his own functions and fell into stillness. Despite being an intelligent construct, Bennu possesses a remarkably vivid personality. Serious and earnest, he detests having his plans disrupted, and has little tolerance for irresponsible colleagues.

customize.name: Al-Ahmar
customize.desc: The ruler of the Sumeru desert. He is also known as King Deshret, Amun, and Scarlet King.

customize.name: Shesepankh
customize.desc: One of King Deshret's Seven Pillars, Saint Shesepankh, the Most-Holy. Shesepankh is an intelligent construct fashioned by King Deshret Al-Ahmar, who entrusted him with the duty of overseeing all the Jinn of the world. Shesepankh possesses a will of his own. Following the passing of King Deshret Al-Ahmar, he ceased his own functions and fell into stillness.

customize.name: Hermanubis
customize.desc: One of King Deshret's Seven Pillars, Saint Hermanubis, the Greatest of Sages. The only one among the Seven Pillars to ascend from humanity to the rank of a god's familiar. Born of the Tighnar people, he was a sage and warrior known far and wide. Sincere, steadfast, kind, and steady, he earned widespread respect. He was the guide of all priests, and within the academic world, he is honored as a foundational figure of desert civilization.

customize.name: Candace
customize.desc: A descendant of King Deshret with an amber left eye. The defender of Aaru Village.

customize.text: The protector of Aaru Village and the heir of King Deshret carries a shield with Bennu's image, so he can contact her at any time.

customize.name: Dialogues of the Desert Sages
customize.desc: A caduceus symbolizing the glory of alchemy, made from special alloys to match its special status. It is exceedingly rigid and heavy, and would probably hurt pretty bad if used as a cudgel.
